sheets.title: A device passkey that cannot seal — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: A virtual platform authenticator that does not answer PRF, as Windows Hello is reported to behave. Pressing the seal key no longer leaves a key that seems to do nothing: the form moves itself to Security key, ready for the next press. No mark, no error.
sheets.before: Passkey tab only; nothing changes on the form, the failure only in the tray
sheets.after: Security key selected (94×44), ready for the next press; no mark, no error notice
